source_verification: Normal web open returned zero readable lines; catalog rule supplied by coordinator was legally read; tweet not independently verified
catalog_rule: 日线波动突破0.8倍振幅持有1日；进场价=昨日收盘+0.8×(最高-最低)，持有1日收盘离场
entry: Previous day's close + 0.8 * previous day's (high-low); one long stop buy per UTC day if high>=level, raw fill=max(open,level)
exit: Same entry-day close; one round trip maximum, daily flat
sizing: Notional equals 95% of pre-entry cash; fee charged in addition, fractional quantities
cost_sensitivity_definition: Fee bps per side changed; slippage remains 2 bps per side
benchmark: 95% initial cash buy-and-hold, first evaluation open, same 8bps fee+2bps slippage, no terminal liquidation
assumptions: BTCUSDT is selected crypto instance, not verified author's explicit asset
Holding one day means entry-day close, not next-day close
Stop orders fully filled when daily high reaches level; intraday crossing time and executability unproven
No leverage, shorting, stop loss, cash interest, funding, tax, lot filter or market impact
prior_trials: unknown; same period already exposed in M0216
data_profile: Explicit coordinator-authorized frozen spot archive diagnostic, not V3 perp bundle; native data retained; PIT/tradability not proven
selection_reason: Catalog stable ID and one-day OHLC rule fit existing verified spot sample, not selected by backtest performance
